        await ctx.recorder.step(idx, tool, hidden_text.sanitize(thought), args, hidden_text.sanitize(result), url,
                                result.get("screenshot_url"))
        for friction in ctx.frictions[frictions_before:]:
            await ctx.recorder.friction(
                idx, "site", friction["severity"],
                hidden_text.sanitize(trace_safety.scrub(friction["expected"])),
                hidden_text.sanitize(trace_safety.scrub(friction["happened"])),
            )
        for issue in ctx.agent_issues[issues_before:]:
            await ctx.recorder.friction(
            _claim_takes_worker_id = False
            print("claim_run does not take a worker id yet (run the last lines of supabase/schema.sql); "
                  "claiming without one.", flush=True)
            response = await database.rpc("claim_run").execute()
    else:
        response = await database.rpc("claim_run").execute()
    run = response.data[0] if response.data else None
    if run is not None and worker_id and run.get("worker_id") is None and "worker_id" not in _missing_columns:
        run["worker_id"] = worker_id
        await _update_run(run["id"], {"worker_id": worker_id})
    return run


async def add_step(
    run_id: str,
    idx: int,
    tool: str,
    thought: str,
    input: dict,
    result: dict,
    url: str | None,
    screenshot_path: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    await (await client()).table("steps").insert({
        "run_id": run_id,
        "idx": idx,
        "tool": tool,
        "thought": thought,
        "input": input,
        "result": result,
        "url": url,
        "screenshot_path": screenshot_path,
    }).execute()


async def add_friction(
    run_id: str,
    step_idx: int | None,
    kind: str,
    severity: str | None,
    expected: str,
        "error": f"Stale: still running after {minutes} minutes (worker stopped or crashed).",
        "finished_at": _now(),
    }).eq("status", "running").lt("started_at", cutoff).execute()
    return response.data


async def upload_screenshot(run_id: str, local_path: Path) -> str:
    """Upload a PNG or JPEG to the public screenshots bucket and return its public URL."""
    storage_path = f"{run_id}/{local_path.name}"
    bucket = (await client()).storage.from_(BUCKET)
    content_type = "image/jpeg" if local_path.suffix.lower() in (".jpg", ".jpeg") else "image/png"
    await bucket.upload(
        storage_path,
        local_path.read_bytes(),
        {"content-type": content_type, "x-upsert": "true"},
    )
    return await bucket.get_public_url(storage_path)


class RunRecorder:
    """Writes one run's steps, frictions and screenshots to Supabase as they happen."""

    def __init__(self, run_id: str):
        self.run_id = run_id

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"RunRecorder(run_id={self.run_id!r})"

    async def upload_screenshot(self, path: Path) -> str:
        """Upload one step's screenshot; do() calls this so the URL can go into its span output."""
        return await upload_screenshot(self.run_id, path)

    async def first_impression(self, review: dict) -> None:
        """Save the first-impression review as soon as it is written, so the live page can show it."""
        await _update_run(self.run_id, {"first_impression": review})

    async def step(self, idx, tool, thought, input, result, url, screenshot_url: str | None) -> None:
        await add_step(self.run_id, idx, tool, thought, input, result, url, screenshot_url)

    async def friction(self, step_idx, kind, severity, expected, happened) -> None:
        await add_friction(self.run_id, step_idx, kind, severity, expected, happened)

205:The `title` attribute is used to set the title of the document. It can be defined as a simple [string](#string) or an optional [template object](#template).
243:`title.template` can be used to add a prefix or a suffix to `titles` defined in **child** route segments.
285:> - `title.template` applies to **child** route segments and **not** the segment it's defined in. This means:
286:>   - `title.default` is **required** when you add a `title.template`.
287:>   - `title.template` defined in `layout.js` will not apply to a `title` defined in a `page.js` of the same route segment.
288:>   - `title.template` defined in `page.js` has no effect because a page is always the terminating segment (it doesn't have any children route segments).
289:> - `title.template` has **no effect** if a route has not defined a `title` or `title.default`.
293:`title.absolute` can be used to provide a title that **ignores** `title.template` set in parent segments.
338:>   - `title` (string) and `title.default` define the default title for child segments (that do not define their own `title`). It will augment `title.template` from the closest parent segment if it exists.
339:>   - `title.absolute` defines the default title for child segments. It ignores `title.template` from parent segments.
340:>   - `title.template` defines a new title template for child segments.
342:>   - If a page does not define its own title the closest parents resolved title will be used.
343:>   - `title` (string) defines the routes title. It will augment `title.template` from the closest parent segment if it exists.
344:>   - `title.absolute` defines the route title. It ignores `title.template` from parent segments.
345:>   - `title.template` has no effect in `page.js` because a page is always the terminating segment of a route.
391:#### `metadataBase`
393:`metadataBase` is a convenience option to set a base URL prefix for `metadata` fields that require a fully qualified URL.
395:- `metadataBase` allows URL-based `metadata` fields defined in the **current route segment and below** to use a **relative path** instead of an otherwise required absolute URL.
396:- The field's relative path will be composed with `metadataBase` to form a fully qualified URL.
400:  metadataBase: new URL('https://acme.com'),
423:> - `metadataBase` is typically set in root `app/layout.js` to apply to URL-based `metadata` fields across all routes.
424:> - When `generateMetadata` uses `'use cache'`, its return value must be serializable. `URL` instances are not supported by Cache Functions, so values such as `metadataBase` should be returned as strings (for example, `url.toString()`). See [`use cache` serialization requirements](/docs/app/api-reference/directives/use-cache#serialization).

# Screenshots of the changed pages at phone and desktop width, and a check of the URL field's paste/blur cleanup.
import asyncio, sys
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
OUT = sys.argv[1]
BASE = "http://localhost:3123"
RUN = "/run/631236d8-c32f-4124-b0af-5d63cda81c61"
BRIEF = "/brief/8ca3896f-a3d8-475f-b810-5c9b6b98bb9e"

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch()
        for w, h in ((390, 844), (1280, 900)):
            ctx = await b.new_context(viewport={"width": w, "height": h}, permissions=["clipboard-read", "clipboard-write"])
            page = await ctx.new_page()
            await page.goto(BASE + RUN, wait_until="networkidle")
            steps = page.locator("#fu-r-steps")
            await steps.scroll_into_view_if_needed(); await page.wait_for_timeout(800)
            await steps.screenshot(path=f"{OUT}/steps-{w}.png")
            print(w, "borrowed labels:", await page.get_by_text("Screenshot from step").count(),
                  "empty boxes:", await page.get_by_text("No screenshot for this step").count())
            await page.locator("#step-5 button").first.click(); await page.wait_for_timeout(300)
            print(w, "lightbox from step 5 shows:", await page.locator("#fu-lightbox [aria-label^='Screenshot']").count() or await page.locator("#fu-lightbox").get_attribute("aria-label"))
            await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
            await page.goto(BASE + BRIEF, wait_until="networkidle"); await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
            share = page.locator("#share-title").locator("xpath=ancestor::section[1]")
            await share.scroll_into_view_if_needed(); await share.screenshot(path=f"{OUT}/brief-share-{w}.png")
            print(w, "brief text:", (await share.locator("textarea").input_value())[:120])
            tabs = page.get_by_role("tab", name="Founder brief")
            if await tabs.count():
                await tabs.click(); await page.wait_for_timeout(300)
                print(w, "founder text:", await page.locator("textarea").last.input_value(), "| url:", page.url)
            await page.goto(BASE + "/#fu-form", wait_until="networkidle"); await page.wait_for_timeout(600)
            field = page.locator("#fu-url")
            await field.click()
            await page.evaluate("navigator.clipboard.writeText('  HTTPS://www.Example.com/app  ')")
            await page.keyboard.press("Control+V")
            print(w, "after paste:", repr(await field.input_value()))
            await field.fill("http://www.foo.dev/x "); await page.locator("#fu-goal").click()
            print(w, "after blur:", repr(await field.input_value()))
            await field.fill("www.keep.dev"); await page.locator("#fu-goal").click()
            print(w, "www kept:", repr(await field.input_value()))
            await page.locator("#fu-url").scroll_into_view_if_needed()
            await page.locator("#fu-form").screenshot(path=f"{OUT}/form-{w}.png")
            await page.goto(BASE + "/", wait_until="networkidle")
            sw = await page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth")
            print(w, "home scrollWidth:", sw)
            await ctx.close()
        await b.close()
asyncio.run(main())
EOF

content.text:
All four fixes are in. Web tests (77 passing), typecheck, lint and the production build all pass, and I checked each change in Chrome at 390 px and 1280 px. Nothing is committed and I didn't read any env file. No worker code was changed.

## 4 · Missing screenshots: the cause is in the worker
For run `631236d8`, only `do` steps have a screenshot linked in the database. Every `look` step (1, 5, 9, 14, 16) and the `finish` step (17) show none.

- **`look` screenshots are taken and uploaded, but never linked to the step.** The files `look_1.png`, `look_5.png`, `look_9.png`, `look_14.png` and `look_16.png` are all in the storage bucket. But `look()` in `worker/tools.py` (~line 311) never puts the URL in its result, so the step row gets an empty screenshot field.
- **`finish` never takes a screenshot**, by design.
- **Nothing failed to upload.**
- **I couldn't check run `665db5d4`.** The production API says that run doesn't exist, and the brief API doesn't know it either. My attempt to query the database directly with a local script was blocked by the permission system. If that run is in a different database, send me where to look.

**Web fix (done):** a step without its own screenshot now shows the nearest earlier one, with a "Screenshot from step N" label, and clicking it opens that screenshot in the lightbox. Step 1 still shows the empty box because nothing comes before it.

**Proposed worker fix (not applied, needs a redeploy):** in `look()`, add `result["screenshot_url"] = url` inside the existing `if url := await publish_image(...)` block. The model never sees `screenshot_url`, because `browse.py` strips it before sending results. Older runs will keep using the fallback either way. Say if you want me to make that change.

## 1 · Share on the brief page
- The share panel moved to `app/share-panel.tsx`, and the report and the brief now both use it, with your two default texts.
- On the Founder brief tab the panel switches to the founder text, and its link ends in `?tab=founder`, which opens that tab directly.
- Founder brief is turned off in my local build, so I only checked that tab's text with a unit test, not in the browser.

## 2 · URL fields
- Pasting or leaving the field now strips leading spaces, `http://` or `https://` (any case), and a `www.` only when it came right after the protocol. A bare `www.` is kept.
- This covers the hero field, the test/Understand field and the start link. Tests are in `lib/url-input.test.ts`.
- In the browser, pasting `  HTTPS://www.Example.com/app  ` gave `Example.com/app`.
- The start link now has the same fixed `https://` prefix, so the stripped value reads correctly.
- Since the server adds `https://` to every address, a pasted `http://` site will be tested over https.
- Removing `www.` can break sites that only answer on `www`.

## 3 · Branding
- **Icons:** `icon.svg` (the lime mark), a 32 px `icon.png`, a 180 px `apple-icon.png`, and `favicon.ico` replaced with the new mark.
- **Titles:** site title, description and page titles are exactly as you specified, checked in the served HTML. For example, `saucedemo.com: A first-time visitor got through · First User`.
- **Report descriptions:** they start with the verdict, e.g. "Verdict: Stuck. …".
- **Share card:** a 1200×630 image (`public/og.png`) in the design's dark style, with the wordmark, "BEFORE" in lime and the tagline. Every page links to it with a large X card.
  - It's a file in `public/` rather than Next's automatic image file, because pages that set their own share fields were dropping the automatic image.
  - Card links point at `https://firstuser-dv.vercel.app`, set in `lib/site.ts`.

The unused default Next.js SVGs are still in `web/public/`. I can delete them if you like.
